title: Sarvam Launches Open Weights Prism Model for Fast Enterprise Decisions
summary:
The AI startup has unveiled Sarvam Prism, a "System One" model built to optimize the speed of decision-making across business processes. Based on the Sarvam 105B architecture, the tool is designed to handle enterprise workflows with low latency and has been made available to the public as open weights.

Prism recorded a score of 71.8 and a median response time of 44 milliseconds. Sarvam stated that this is the highest average score ever achieved by a decision model capable of responding in under 100 milliseconds.
